change.reason: The 2026-Q3 policy declared a ten-year window and market-bars-v2. Development holds neither, so every official run failed before simulation (root #471, backtest-engine #82). v2 states the window and schema Development can actually replay; v1 is retired, not edited.
change.instruction: Development 2026-Q3 실행 정책 v2 게시 — version: development-official-backtest-2026-q3-v2, periodStart: 2024-01-01T05:00:00Z, periodEnd: 2024-02-01T05:00:00Z, marketDataSchemaVersion: market-bars/1, datasetManifestId: 7f7113c9-3b02-4098-97ec-0baa07e2b3b0, datasetHash: 08a848a5f9aa1aac80e215c2d86bcf6d5f96c354400c7c16394dae9ffa9939af, 기존 v1은 DB 증거를 보존하되 활성 runtime catalog에서는 v2만 선택되도록 retire 처리
change.supersededHandling: The policy seed is append-only by design: the bootstrap refuses any statement that could rewrite an already published policy row, so v1 keeps its row and its artifact hash untouched. v1 stops being reachable because the runtime catalog file carries v2 alone and the producer guard refuses v1's ten-year window and market-bars-v2 schema against every AVAILABLE manifest.
